title: When set to show "applications:/Games"; panel button shows "unknown" icon instead of correct icon
line: A Folder View in the panel showing applications:/Games/ now shows a folder icon instead of the unknown icon.
explanation: FolderModel::iconName() built a fresh KFileItem from the bare URL. For virtual locations such as applications:/Games/ that item can't know it is a folder, so its MIME type falls back to application/octet-stream and the panel button shows the unknown icon. The model now takes the icon from a copy of the dir lister's root item once the folder is listed (falling back to the old item before that), and announces iconNameChanged when listing completes. A copy is used so a changed .directory icon is still picked up.

commits.message:
folder: use the listed root item for the widget icon

The icon was taken from a KFileItem built from the bare URL, which can't
know the type of virtual locations like applications:/Games/ and showed
the unknown icon. Use the lister's root item once listed, like Dolphin.

BUG: 294572

media.caption: Panel Folder Views for applications:/Games/, desktop:/, ~/Documents and applications:/: the Games one shows the '?' unknown icon
Same widgets with the fix: applications:/Games/ shows a folder icon (as Dolphin's location bar does)

review.text: Sound fix in FolderModel that uses KCoreDirLister's rootItem() once listing completes (falling back to the bare URL beforehand) and emits iconNameChanged() on completion. Constructing a fresh KFileItem from the listed root item's UDSEntry and URL fixes virtual KIO locations like applications:/Games/ to match Dolphin's folder icon instead of showing the unknown icon, while still picking up live .directory icon edits. Verification screenshots and regression checks are thorough and honest.

reviews.text: Sound fix in FolderModel that uses KCoreDirLister's rootItem() once listing completes (falling back to the bare URL beforehand) and emits iconNameChanged() on completion. Constructing a fresh KFileItem from the listed root item's UDSEntry and URL fixes virtual KIO locations like applications:/Games/ to match Dolphin's folder icon instead of showing the unknown icon, while still picking up live .directory icon edits. Verification screenshots and regression checks are thorough and honest.

Right root cause: FolderModel::iconName() built a KFileItem from the bare URL, which cannot resolve virtual locations; using a copy of the lister's root item (as Dolphin does) and emitting iconNameChanged on completion is small and clean in the right repo. The result (a folder icon) matches what the latest commenter (c6/c8) and Dolphin's location bar show, and the screenshots confirm the '?' becomes a folder while Documents/applications:/ stay unchanged. The desktop:/ widget now showing user-desktop is a sensible side effect consistent with Dolphin; worth one line in the commit message but not blocking.
